syllabus.title: AITS:5 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Oscillations, Waves, Electric Charges and Fields + 30% Questions from cumulative syllabus of previously conducted all AITS test.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Organic Chemistry: Isomerism, Organic Chemistry: General Organic Chemistry, Hydrocarbon +30% Questions from cumulative syllabus of previously conducted all AITS test.

📌 BOTANY
• Anatomy of Flowering Plants + 30% Questions from cumulative syllabus of previously conducted all AITS test.

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Animal Kingdom, Human Reproduction + 30% Questions from cumulative syllabus of previously conducted all AITS test.
